title: Information Inquiry: Custom Actors, Classes, Weapons, Items, etc.

posts.author: martmatt
posts.body:
Hey all,
First, I am new here so If this thread is in the wrong place, let me know and I will move it
Second, I am making a game but cannot figure out
for the life of me
how it is that one makes custom Actors, Classes, Weapons, and Items. I
do
know how to put my custom sprites on existing Actors,
but not how to build my own from scratch.
If there is a plugin with a GUI that would be cool, but even just a tutorial on how to do it from a scripting standpoint would work.
I have done some googling and found nothing on this, so any help would be appreciated!

posts.author: KK20
posts.body: Confused on what it is that you're asking for. The impression I'm getting is that you never clicked on the "Change Maximum..." button in the database to create more entries.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
Have you done any tutorials on the software? Or read through the help file?
Editing the values in the database entry (and, as pointed out, making more entries to fill out) is probably the most basic thing that should be covered.
This series (the first that came up when I typed "rpg maker xp tutorial" into YouTube) does a bit of mapping as its first video, then goes through the database in the second.
martmatt said:
If there is a plugin with a GUI that would be cool
Click to expand...
RPG Maker XP can't use plugins.
